note: Tier2 as FILTER on original ORTHRUS ranking (correct per Note.md RQ1a), vs re-rank. 2250 alerts = global top-2250 by ORTHRUS score. GT=12/114 present in this window. Metrics: OOF TF-IDF 5-fold. Threshold 0.5.
dataset: H051 test 23-25/09, top-2250 alerts, GT 12 pos / 2238 neg

filter_V1_generic_IDS.method: TF-IDF char_wb(2,5) 50k + LogReg balanced, OOF 5-fold, threshold 0.5 applied to original top-k

filter_V2_msg_enriched.method: same, but texts include real msg from nid2msg_cache.pkl (self_label + parent msg + event src/dst msg)

rerank_by_TFIDF_OOF.note: Alternative: sort all 2250 by TF-IDF OOF score instead of original score. Shows H0 as primary detector, not just filter.

interpretation: V2 msg-enriched improves OOF AP 0.184->0.254 and recall after filter 0.333->0.5 at k=2000, but destroys recall at k<=1000 because original top-k contains only 1 GT (low-k is hopeless for any filter). As re-ranker, TF-IDF beats ORTHRUS: top-100 TF-IDF 6-8 TP vs original 1 TP. This is RQ1b gain, but as filter at fixed recall it loses 50% GT. SLM must beat 0.254 AP and 0.5 recall @ 0.97 FP reduction to justify.
next: Run SLM tier2 on V2 at k=2000 with same OOF protocol; compare FP reduction at matched recall (0.5). Also measure latency per alert for TF-IDF ~ms vs SLM ~seconds to build Pareto.
